r.경제 체제: Market economy · pharmaceuticals, car parts, logistics

r.빅맥지수: $7.08 for a Big Mac, $0.86 more than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist, euro-area average)

r.정치 구도: A parliamentary system; it became independent from Yugoslavia in 1991.

t.why: A member of the EU, NATO and the eurozone.
t.rel: It declared independence on the same day as Croatia in 1991 and left Yugoslavia after a war of just ten days or so. It once disputed its sea boundary with Croatia.
t.know: It is known for the church on the island in Lake Bled.
t.etext: Strong in pharmaceuticals, car parts, appliances and logistics. The port of Koper is central Europe's gateway to the sea.
